nodes.name: Prostatakarzinom
nodes.summary: Patient-19 has a clinical diagnosis of C61 Prostatakarzinom (adenocarcinoma of the prostate, Gleason-Score 3+4=7, ISUP 2, staged as cT2c cN0 cM0), characterized by early biochemical recurrence following radical prostatectomy. The condition is managed with salvage radiotherapy and androgen deprivation therapy (ADT). Following salvage radiation of the prostate bed (66 Gy) in April 2028 with a PSA of 0.9 ng/ml, the patient maintained a stable clinical course with a good general condition (ECOG 2) and persistently low or undetectable PSA levels (<0.1 ng/ml through September 2029), showing no evidence of disease progression.
